body: **When forming a company in the UK**

It is mandatory to attach an apostilled certificate to company documents while opening a business bank account or opening a new branch in a foreign land. For the formation of companies on foreign land, this certificate is very important. At Brixen Consultants, we can avail the best-Apostilled service. This service can be used in legalising a range of company documents that includes a memorandum, certificate of incorporation, Certificate of Good standing, etc. On request, we prepare additional documents as well.

Apostilled Documents can help you prove authenticity and can be used for the formation of companies in the UK.Non-UK residents who wish to set up a limited company formation in the UK are required to legalize all company documents in order to verify their authenticity. This is an important step that is performed in every foreign country to judge the authenticity of the organization. An Apostilled certificate is attached to all company documents to state that they are all authentic and can be used for the formation of companies in the UK. The documents may include –
Form IN01 (The application to register a limited company)

To gain that certificate, you need to hire an expert service. At Brixen Consultants, you can avail of the apostilled documents service by our expert professionals who hold many years of experience and knowledge in this field.

The certificate of authentication is provided by the Notary who verifies the authenticity of the documents. An Apostilled certificate is attached to the verified document by the Foreign Commonwealth and Development Office. Their offered certification ensures that the documents of the company will be accepted across all countries.

items: Choose from buy now option, fill the application form with all required details, and checkout and pay

The original copy of the apostilled document will be sent to you via your selected delivery method.
